name: WTK
recent: WTK 近期有两项资产出售：以 RM38 million 出售槟城工业地产给 NationGate 子公司，并在 EGM 上通过以 RM221.50 million 出售种植资产及 Positive Deal 65% 股权给 Trinity Capital Resources。同时，集团 CEO Dato' Sri Patrick Wong Haw Yeong 在 9 月底至 10 月初多次增持股份。
notable: 以 RM38 million 现金出售槟城 Seberang Perai Tengah 三块工业租赁地及地上资产给 NationGate System Sdn. Bhd.。
EGM 通过以 RM221.50 million 现金出售 Positive Deal 65% 股权及相关种植资产给 Trinity Capital Resources Sdn. Bhd.。
集团 CEO Dato' Sri Patrick Wong Haw Yeong 在 9 月 30 日至 10 月 2 日期间多次增持公司股份。
risks: 集团 CEO 在 2026 年 11 月 20 日公告有意在闭市期交易公司股份。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM195.19 million，环比增长 48.7%，同比增长 41.3%；净利为 RM60.52 million，净利率 31.0%，环比及同比分别增长 732.7% 和 247.1%。

recent_en: WTK recently undertook two asset disposals: the sale of Penang industrial properties to a NationGate subsidiary for RM38 million, and shareholder approval at an EGM for the RM221.50 million disposal of plantation assets and 65% of Positive Deal to Trinity Capital Resources. Meanwhile, Group CEO Dato' Sri Patrick Wong Haw Yeong acquired shares multiple times in late September and early October.
notable_en: Disposed of three parcels of industrial leasehold land with assets in Seberang Perai Tengah, Penang, to NationGate System Sdn. Bhd. for RM38 million cash.
EGM approved the disposal of 65% equity interest in Positive Deal and related plantation assets to Trinity Capital Resources Sdn. Bhd. for RM221.50 million cash.
Group CEO Dato' Sri Patrick Wong Haw Yeong acquired shares in the company multiple times between 30 September and 2 October.
risks_en: The Group CEO announced on 20 November 2026 an intention to deal in company shares during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM195.19 million, up 48.7% QoQ and 41.3% YoY; net income was RM60.52 million with a net margin of 31.0%, up 732.7% QoQ and 247.1% YoY.
